messages:
nina_k: created a docs PR to expand the Nebula3b model card: added embed sharding guidance, updated the 'limits' table for sharded configs, and uploaded a small benchmark CSV. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102 

ben_s: nice. can we also add a short guidance line under 'Dedicated' and 'Private' sections noting how shard placement interacts with GPU partitioning? customers asked about pinning shards to hosts.

zara_p: +1 to that. Also suggest adding a tiny JS and Go SDK snippet so our multi-language users have examples. I can draft JS.

nina_k: pushed a draft JS snippet in the PR comments. sample: 

```javascript
// preferred: client-side shard hint + batch helper
import Redwood from 'redwood-client'
const client = new Redwood({ key: process.env.RW_KEY })
const inputs = ['q1','q2','q3']
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'nebula3b-embed', inputs, shard_count: 2 })
console.log(resp.data.length)
```

ben_s: looks good. i added a tiny Go snippet too in the PR note. we should ensure both snippets call out truncation behavior.

zara_p: i found a broken reference to the old 'embed-sharding.md' link in the catalog card. ci-bot will catch it but we should fix before merge.

ci-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken link (https://olddocs.redwood.ai/embed-sharding).

nina_k: updated the link to https://docs.redwood.ai/embed_sharding (pushed).

docs-bot: PR opened by nina_k: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102  labels: docs, model-card, needs-review.

ben_s: benchmark note  attached: 2-shard gives ~1.6x throughput vs single on our test set; 4-shard marginal gains past 3 for long sequences. added a short sentence in 'benchmarks' caveat.

zara_p: minor copy edits. also can we add a migration snippet for customers still using the old /v1/embeds endpoint? simple find/replace guide.

nina_k: added Migration section with an example sed command and an SDK mapping table. left TODO for linking to the SDK changelog.

ben_s: LGTM from infra side, but would like an explicit callout about 99th latency regression when shards span hosts vs colocated. noted in PR.

zara_p: i'll polish the JS snippet and add a one-line Go example. keeping the old sync API in an appendix with deprecation note.

ci-bot: docs build failed: markdownlint warning + linkcheck passed after fixes.

docs-bot: merge requested by nina_k after approvals.

nina_k: thanks all 44f planning to publish model-catalog update after merge; ping me if you want to hand off the live card publish.

ben_s: can we also add a short perf tip: prefer shard_count that matches batch granularity to avoid uneven shard loads. i added wording.

zara_p: done. merging once CI green. :shipit:
